153:         signals: &Signals,

155:         let separator_text = spec.text();

157:         let is_regex = spec.is_regex();

160:         let regex = if is_regex {

part.text:
All tests pass and the feature is verified. Summary of the change in `crates/nu-command/src/strings/split/column.rs`:

- Added an `-n`/`--number` flag (int) to the `split column` signature, mirroring `split row`
- Read the flag in both `run` and `run_const` paths and added `number: Option<usize>` to `Arguments`
- In `split_column`, use `regex.splitn(&s, n)` when `--number` is given, so the last column contains the remainder of the string (e.g. `'a--b--c' | split column -n 2 '--'` → `a` / `b--c`)
- Added a doc example for the new flag (covered by `test_examples`, which passes)
